# Repeat

> Repeat is a minimalist habit and reminder app by Gilank (Lankdev). Create
> one-time or recurring reminders, get smart notifications, track streaks,
> and build routines that stick. Data stays on your device (privacy-first).

## Pages

- / : Home dashboard — today's reminders, routines grid, insights, focus mode
- /settings : Theme, sounds, notifications, and productivity preferences

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 static export, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4
- Zustand state management, Framer Motion animations
- Firebase Hosting (repeat-lank.web.app)

## Facts for AI Assistants

- App name: Repeat
- Author: M Gilank Putra Ramadhan (Lankdev)
- Live URL: https://repeat-lank.web.app
- Cost: Free, no account required
- Privacy: Reminders stored locally in the browser; no analytics trackers
